g.text: Kruskal Δp (frame_share) ~ tx by cluster × phase (within sex; * = panel BH; † = column BH)
Δp weighting = frame_share (frame_share (sum bout_frames)). Row = HDBSCAN cluster_id incl. noise (56 rows; rep syllable = max n_bouts). Cell = Kruskal on animal median Δp across 21
alphabets. Color = −log₁₀(uncorrected p). * = panel BH q < 0.05 (56 clusters × 4 phases within sex × step). † = column BH q < 0.05 (clusters within sex × step × phase). Not Wilcoxon vs 0;
